name: Commercial AMC Contracts
tagline: AMC contracts for commercial AC fleets
headline: Every AC in Your Building, Handled Under One Contract
summary: One contract for every AC across your premises — offices, schools, hospitals, restaurants. Quarterly preventive maintenance keeps units efficient through 40°C summers and salty coastal air, and an SLA keeps breakdowns short. One account manager, one consolidated GST invoice, and a health report on every unit, every quarter.

symptoms.title: Breakdowns during business hours
symptoms.description: A unit fails at 2 pm on a 40°C day and every fix becomes an emergency call to whichever technician picks up.

symptoms.title: No service records
symptoms.description: Nobody can say when any given unit was last cleaned, gassed, or checked, so failures always arrive as surprises.

symptoms.title: Electricity bills creeping up
symptoms.description: Choked coils and low gas across a fleet raise consumption quietly, and the cost hides inside one large EB bill.

symptoms.title: Multiple vendors, multiple invoices
symptoms.description: Accounts chases separate cash bills from different technicians every month, with no GST paperwork to file against.

symptoms.title: Units ageing unevenly
symptoms.description: The ACs near reception get attention while the ones above the kitchen or server room corrode in humid, greasy air until they fail.

pricing.label: Semi-comprehensive AMC

benefits.title: An SLA you can hold us to
benefits.description: Breakdown response is written into the contract, not promised on a phone call. Same-day slots and 60-90 minute reach in covered areas, with escalation straight to your account manager.

benefits.title: One person owns your fleet
benefits.description: A single account manager tracks every unit, every visit, and every pending repair. Your facilities team makes one call, not twelve.

benefits.title: Reports that make budgeting possible
benefits.description: Quarterly health and consumption reports flag which units are declining, so replacements are planned line items instead of emergency purchases.

benefits.title: Crews built for commercial sites
benefits.description: Background-verified, uniformed technicians trained across Daikin, Blue Star, Carrier, Mitsubishi Electric, and every major brand. Repairs carry up to a 90-day service warranty.

process.title: Free site survey
process.description: We walk your premises, tag every unit, and record age, condition, and gas type before quoting a single rupee.

process.title: Contract built per fleet
process.description: You pick the tier, we fix the SLA, visit calendar, and consolidated billing cycle in writing.

process.title: Quarterly maintenance visits
process.description: Uniformed crews service every tagged unit against a checklist, scheduled outside your business hours where needed.

process.title: Report, review, warranty
process.description: Each quarter closes with a fleet health report and an account-manager review; repairs done under the contract carry up to a 90-day service warranty.

faqs.question: Which premises and AC types do you cover?
faqs.answer: Offices, schools, hospitals, restaurants, clinics, and retail spaces across Chennai. We service mixed fleets — split, window, cassette, ducted, and VRF — across all major brands including Daikin, Blue Star, Voltas, Carrier, and Mitsubishi Electric. One contract covers the lot.

faqs.question: How is a commercial AMC priced?
faqs.answer: Per unit, per year, by tier — non-comprehensive from ₹1,499, semi-comprehensive from ₹2,499, comprehensive from ₹3,999. The final quote is set after a free site survey, because a five-year-old cassette above a restaurant kitchen is not the same risk as a two-year-old split in a cabin. Larger fleets attract per-fleet rates.

faqs.question: What does the SLA actually commit to?
faqs.answer: Same-day slots for breakdown calls and 60-90 minute reach in covered areas, written into the contract. Contract clients are booked ahead of walk-in work. If a repair needs parts, your account manager gives you a firm timeline before the technician leaves.

faqs.question: Can visits happen outside business hours?
faqs.answer: Yes. Restaurants get serviced before lunch prep, schools during holidays, and hospital wards on a rotation your administrator signs off. The quarterly calendar is agreed at contract start and your account manager confirms each visit in advance.

faqs.question: Who pays for parts and gas during the contract?
faqs.answer: It depends on your tier. Non-comprehensive contracts bill parts and gas separately at rates fixed in the contract — a top-up from ₹1,499, for instance. Comprehensive contracts absorb parts, gas, and labour, including PCB and compressor work. Every repair is documented on a digital GST invoice either way.
